# IT Support Ticket Incident Resolution Summary
Ticket Ref: INC-84920-GP

## Ticket Information
- User Name: Colleen Kim
- Department: Underwriting Operations
- Organisation: Granite Peak Financial
- Assigned Specialist: Grace Haddad
- Escalation Reviewer: Teresa Ferreira
- Date Opened: 03/12/2026 08:45 AM EST
- Date Resolved: 03/12/2026 11:15 AM EST

## Hardware Inventory & Connectivity
| Device | Asset Tag | Model / Spec | Port Used |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Workstation | GP-LT-4402 | Latitude 5440 (Intel Iris Xe) | Thunderbolt 4 |
| Docking Station | GP-DK-1188 | Universal USB-C Dock 130W | Dual DisplayPort |
| Monitor 1 | GP-MN-0912 | 27-inch 1440p 75Hz (Primary) | DP 1 (Active) |
| Monitor 2 | GP-MN-0913 | 27-inch 1440p 75Hz (Secondary) | DP 2 (Inactive) |

## Diagnostic Findings
Specialist Grace Haddad established a remote assistance session via Quick Assist at 09:10 AM. Preliminary hardware checks revealed:
- Monitor 1 functions normally at 2560x1440 resolution via DP 1.
- Monitor 2 power LED is steady amber, displaying no signal detected over DP 2.
- Direct connection test: Monitor 2 connected directly to workstation HDMI port displays normal desktop output.
- Cable swap test: Swapping DP 1 and DP 2 cables between monitors shifts the blank screen to Monitor 1.
- Device Manager shows all display adapter drivers up to date as of driver package v31.0.101.4578.

## Resolution Steps Taken
- Dispatched replacement DisplayPort cable from local inventory to user workstation.
- Replaced Monitor 2 because the direct HDMI test confirmed hardware failure inside the panel itself.
- Advised Colleen Kim to power down the docking station and perform hardware reconnect.
- Verified dual display extended desktop at native 2560x1440 resolution across both screens.
- Confirmed end-user sign-off via Teams messaging at 11:10 AM.

errors.quote: Replaced Monitor 2 because the direct HDMI test confirmed hardware failure inside the panel itself.
errors.explanation: The diagnostic findings state that Monitor 2 showed normal desktop output when connected directly via HDMI, and swapping DP cables moved the failure to Monitor 1, which proves the panel is working and the cable or dock port was faulty, contradicting the claim that the panel had a hardware failure.
errors.fix: Retained Monitor 2 after direct HDMI testing confirmed the panel itself is fully operational.

errors.quote: Advised Colleen Kim to power down the docking station and perform hardware reconnect.
errors.explanation: A complete power cycle instructions line for resolving peripheral docking issues must specify the duration to keep the power disconnected (such as unplugging power for 30 seconds to fully discharge internal capacitors) before reconnecting.
errors.fix: Advised Colleen Kim to unplug the docking station power adapter, wait 30 seconds to clear residual power, and reconnect the cables.
